items.issue: Tier-1 semantic hooks expose names, roles, states, values, focus and live-region metadata; operating-system accessibility bridges require target-platform adapters.
items.workaround: Use the shipped DOM/ARIA overlay on web and qualify native bridges on each target platform.

items.issue: A 24-hour wall-clock soak and clean Linux/macOS installer qualification remain external release-engineering tasks.
items.workaround: Run the supplied stability and platform procedures on named target hardware.

items.issue: Tauri 2.9.6 reports that its optional __TAURI_BUNDLE_TYPE marker is absent while patching MSI/NSIS output. Nova_A 3.6 does not enable the updater plugin; both installers complete.
items.workaround: Normal portable/MSI/NSIS installation is unaffected. Requalify the marker before enabling automatic updates.
